title: Build ordered supercell model
action: Construct a periodic supercell of PbFe0.5Nb0.5O3 by stacking two perovskite unit cells along [001] such that one layer is PbFeO3 and the other is PbNbO3. Create an initial input file for DFT calculation (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x input).
description: The agent defines the atomic species and initial positions in the alternating-layer supercell and writes the input deck for structural relaxation.

title: DFT structure relaxation (vc-relax)
action: Run Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x in vc-relax mode with GGA-PBE functional. Relax both cell parameters and atomic positions to obtain the equilibrium structure.
description: The variable-cell relaxation explores the energy-volume curve and yields the relaxed lattice parameter and atomic coordinates.

title: Extract optimized structure
action: Parse the QE output (or final structure file) to obtain the pseudocubic lattice parameter a (in Å) and the fractional coordinates of all atoms. Write to optimized_structure.csv in the same order as Table 1 of the paper: O, O, O, O, O, O, Fe, Nb, Pb, Pb.
description: CSV file containing the equilibrium lattice parameter and the fractional coordinates of every atom in the relaxed supercell.
output_schema: Columns: lattice_parameter_a_angstrom (float), element (string), x_frac (float), y_frac (float), z_frac (float). First row: element='lattice', lattice_parameter_a_angstrom=<value>, x_frac=y_frac=z_frac=0. Subsequent rows: each atom in the order of Table 1 (O, O, O, O, O, O, Fe, Nb, Pb, Pb).

title: Berry-phase polarization of PbFeO3 and PbNbO3 subcells
action: Using the relaxed structure, perform nscf and Berry-phase polarization calculations with Quantum ESPRESSO to compute the spontaneous polarization of the PbFeO3 and PbNbO3 subcells.
description: Berry-phase evaluation yields the polarization values for each subcell.

title: Extract subcell polarization values
action: Extract the spontaneous polarization values (in μC/cm²) for PbFeO3 and PbNbO3 subcells from the Berry-phase outputs and write to polarization_values.csv.
description: CSV containing the subcell names and their polarization values.
output_schema: Columns: subcell (string), polarization_muC_per_cm2 (float). Two rows: 'PbFeO3' and 'PbNbO3'.
